answer: Put a lien on future income. When an audit proves two identities share an operator, every identity in that linked set becomes jointly liable for the damage any of them caused. The ledger diverts their future earnings to repay victims until the debt clears, and joining the set later does not escape the lien. A farm then holds one shared debt that grows with each clone caught, like a vine whose every new shoot feeds the same root rot. Honest agents never inherit another's debt, while an operator perched on that ledge cannot write a fresh sonnet under a new name.
